newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Sept 5.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Sept 5.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.
-- Cuts in income tax to be presented by Prime Minister Alain Juppe today are considered insufficient by some members of the conservative majority.
-- The franc reaches a six-month low against the mark.
-- Total chairman Thierry Desmarest does not expect rise in oil prices to last, the oil group posts a 45 percent rise in profits for the first half.

-- Cie Generale des Eaux to become a telecommunications operator under the name Cegetel, expects 40 billion francs turnover by 2003, seeks to compete with France Telecom when the telecoms market opens in 1998.
-- Paris CBV Bourse regulators rule in favour of a Caisse des Depots bid on ailing bank Credit Foncier de France notwithstanding legal action by minority shareholders.
